created_by.description: Filter by the creator's user ID.

limit.description: Number of results to return per page.

offset.description: The initial index from which to return the results.

order_by.description: Sort by name, kind, created_at, updated_at, or current_version.

search.description: Search scorers by name or description.

tag_match.description:
Match any selected tag (OR) or all selected tags (AND). Additional tags are allowed.

* `any` - Any
* `all` - All

tags.description: JSON array of tag names, for example ["quality","production"]. Up to 20 tags. An empty array disables tag filtering.
